name: showcase-communities
arguments: MATCH (c:Community) RETURN c.id AS id, c.label AS label, c.heuristicLabel AS heuristicLabel, c.symbolCount AS symbolCount, c.cohesion AS cohesion ORDER BY c.id

name: showcase-memberships
arguments: MATCH (n)-[r:CodeRelation]->(c:Community) WHERE r.type = 'MEMBER_OF' RETURN n.id AS id, n.name AS name, n.filePath AS filePath, c.id AS communityId ORDER BY c.id, n.id

name: showcase-processes
arguments: MATCH (p:Process) RETURN p.id AS id, p.label AS label, p.heuristicLabel AS heuristicLabel, p.stepCount AS stepCount, p.processType AS processType ORDER BY p.id

name: showcase-steps
arguments: MATCH (n)-[r:CodeRelation]->(p:Process) WHERE r.type = 'STEP_IN_PROCESS' RETURN n.id AS id, n.name AS name, n.filePath AS filePath, p.id AS processId, r.step AS step ORDER BY p.id, r.step

name: showcase-relation-types
arguments: MATCH ()-[r:CodeRelation]->() RETURN r.type AS type, count(r) AS count ORDER BY count DESC
